recommendations.json: what to change, by how much and why. Every value links to a node of the derivation graph, which holds its formula with the inputs substituted. Recomputable from the raw files by servtuner analyze.

Schema file: `schema/json/bundle/recommendations.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `ea52778da279`.

## Top level

| Field              | Type                                                                          | Required | Description                                                   |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `analyzer_version` | `string`                                                                      | Yes      |                                                               |
| `operating_point`  | [operatingPoint](/reference/schemas/recommendations/#operatingpoint)          | Yes      |                                                               |
| `policy`           | [sizingPolicy](/reference/schemas/recommendations/#sizingpolicy)              | Yes      |                                                               |
| `recommendations`  | array of [recommendation](/reference/schemas/recommendations/#recommendation) | Yes      |                                                               |
| `derivation`       | `object`                                                                      | Yes      | One graph for the whole run; recommendations name their node. |

## Definitions

### operatingPoint

The load the resources are sized for: the SLO-max stage, or the stage at or above target\_rps. Unavailable when no stage is valid and meets the SLOs; then there are no sizing recommendations.

| Field         | Type                                         | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`        | `"slo_max"`, `"target_rps"`, `"unavailable"` | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `stage_index` | `integer`                                    | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `rps`         | `number`                                     | No       | Achieved RPS of the operating-point stage. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `target_rps`  | `number`                                     | No       | &gt; 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `reason`      | `string`                                     | No       | Why the operating point is unavailable, or why target\_rps was not used.                                                                                                                                                              |
| `caveats`     | array of `string`                            | No       | Caveats about the operating point itself, such as an SLO-max that is only the highest stage tested. Every sizing recommendation also carries them, so one read alone keeps its context; a view of the whole document shows them once. |

### sizingPolicy

The limits policy and headroom that applied, after RunSpec defaults.

| Field          | Type                                             | Required | Description |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `cpu_limit`    | [limitsPolicy](/reference/runspec/#limitspolicy) | Yes      |             |
| `memory_limit` | [limitsPolicy](/reference/runspec/#limitspolicy) | Yes      |             |
| `qos`          | `"burstable"`, `"guaranteed"`                    | Yes      |             |
| `headroom`     | `object`                                         | Yes      |             |

### recommendationTarget

The workload (and container) a recommendation is for. The bench pod itself is never a recommendation target.

| Field            | Type                                                             | Required | Description |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `role`           | [workloadRole](/reference/schemas/target-snapshot/#workloadrole) | Yes      |             |
| `upstream_index` | `integer`                                                        | No       | ≥ 0         |
| `target_type`    | [targetType](/reference/runspec/#targettype)                     | Yes      |             |
| `namespace`      | `string`                                                         | Yes      |             |
| `container`      | `string`                                                         | No       |             |

### recommendationValue

A current or recommended setting: a number in the recommendation's unit, a string (a quantity or a mode), a boolean, or null when unset.

Type: `number or string or boolean or null`

### recommendationEvidence

| Field         | Type      | Required | Description                                                     |
| ------------- | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `text`        | `string`  | Yes      |                                                                 |
| `stage_index` | `integer` | No       | ≥ 0                                                             |
| `series`      | `string`  | No       | A stored series, &lt;catalog&gt;/&lt;name&gt;, or a chart file. |

### recommendation

| Field                 | Type                                                                                          | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                  | `string`                                                                                      | Yes      | Unique in the file and stable across reruns of the same bundle.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `rule`                | `string`                                                                                      | Yes      | The rule that produced it, for example sizing.cpu\_request or B1.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `target`              | [recommendationTarget](/reference/schemas/recommendations/#recommendationtarget)              | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `subject`             | `object`                                                                                      | Yes      | What to change: a resource (cpu.request, memory.limit), a target knob (bifrost.concurrency), replicas, an HPA setting, an environment variable, or advice: a finding to act on that is not one setting (recommended is then a short directive, for example 'scale the upstream'). |
| `unit`                | `string`                                                                                      | No       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `current`             | [recommendationValue](/reference/schemas/recommendations/#recommendationvalue)                | No       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `recommended`         | [recommendationValue](/reference/schemas/recommendations/#recommendationvalue)                | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `min`                 | `number`                                                                                      | No       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `max`                 | `number`                                                                                      | No       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `tier`                | `"diagnostic"`, `"empirical"`                                                                 | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `confidence`          | `"high"`, `"medium"`, `"low"`                                                                 | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `derivation_node`     | `string`                                                                                      | No       | The derivation node whose value is recommended.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `evidence`            | array of [recommendationEvidence](/reference/schemas/recommendations/#recommendationevidence) | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `caveats`             | array of `string`                                                                             | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `is_urgent`           | `boolean`                                                                                     | No       | Act on this first: the evidence shows harm now (for B2, requests dropped or a queue larger than the SLO allows). Absent means not urgent.                                                                                                                                         |
| `followup_experiment` | `string`                                                                                      | No       | A run that would confirm or sharpen the recommendation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

### derivationNode

One value of the derivation graph: measured, a parameter, derived by a formula, or hypothetical.

| Field             | Type                                                                     | Required | Description                                                                                        |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`              | `string`                                                                 | Yes      |                                                                                                    |
| `kind`            | `"measured"`, `"parameter"`, `"derived"`, `"hypothetical"`               | Yes      |                                                                                                    |
| `label`           | `string`                                                                 | Yes      |                                                                                                    |
| `unit`            | `string`                                                                 | No       |                                                                                                    |
| `value`           | `number`                                                                 | Yes      |                                                                                                    |
| `formula`         | `string`                                                                 | No       |                                                                                                    |
| `inputs`          | array of `string`                                                        | No       |                                                                                                    |
| `rendered`        | `string`                                                                 | No       | The formula with its inputs' values substituted, and the result. It parses back to the same value. |
| `is_pinned`       | `boolean`                                                                | No       |                                                                                                    |
| `derivable_value` | `number`                                                                 | No       | What the formula gives, when the value is pinned.                                                  |
| `default`         | `number`                                                                 | No       |                                                                                                    |
| `bounds`          | [derivationBounds](/reference/schemas/recommendations/#derivationbounds) | No       |                                                                                                    |
| `doc`             | `string`                                                                 | No       |                                                                                                    |
| `source`          | `object`                                                                 | No       |                                                                                                    |
| `is_hypothetical` | `boolean`                                                                | No       |                                                                                                    |
